  Public Node Delegation is NOW LIVE!  

How to Delegate Your Node & Earn Rewards 

Scruffy’s back with a quick walkthrough - see link below on how to delegate your node to a public pool and why it matters.

  Why Delegate?
Delegation is now the main way to keep earning rewards. It replaces registration as the primary participation method.
If you're not able or willing to run your own node pool, you can now delegate to others using the Public Pool Delegation system.
Even without running a pool, you can earn rewards just by participating!

 Important Notes:

Previously registered nodes still earn rewards for now — but will eventually need to be delegated.
If your wallet disconnects or your node becomes ineligible via dipping under the required amount of $COPI in your linked wallet, you’ll need to delegate again.
Once delegated, the pool's fee is locked in until you undelegate.

 How To Delegate:

Visit the Public Pool Dashboard to find a pool (use  to favorite!)
Go to Manage Nodes and click “Delegate” on any undelegated node
Pick your pool, review the fee split, and confirm!

 Reward Breakdown:

99% of rewards = participation
1% = performance (subject to change — preview with the toggle on the Rewards page)
Pool fees only apply to the performance portion.

 Pool Operator Note:

Operators must set a pool fee before accepting delegations
Pools can be made private to remove non-self delegations
Go to Manage Pools and click on your existing pools to adjust “Pool Share %”

 Need Help?
Check the COPI Wiki using command - !node - for links and/or drop your questions in ⁠📡│node-owner
